# weyl-magic-obstruction-frontier (0TH-2026-022)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization (22 theorem groups T1a-T5d, 23 Palomar targets, 38 audited declarations) and eight-engine executed polyglot verifier (+ Eshkol AD spec) for the 2-Adic Odd-Qubit Magic Obstruction, n=4 Bent-Hyperplane Rupture, Super-MUB Torsion Anomalies, Two-Stabilizer n=5 SOS Rupture, AME Magic Ceilings, and Divided-Power Characteristic-3 Alltop Constructions.

Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648). Dual licensed: Apache-2.0 (code) and CC-BY-4.0 (paper/docs/data).

## Core Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Executive summary, 5-pillar table, verbatim 38-declaration `#print axioms` audit, quickstart, and polyglot matrix.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line mapping of all 38 audited Lean declarations and explicit paper-to-Lean bridges.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Claim-by-claim falsifiable ledger with epistemic tags (`[LEAN-6K]`, `[EXACT-COMP]`, `[NUMERICAL-APPROX]`, `[OPEN]`) and falsification criteria.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Scope boundaries, open problems, and classical cross-check disclaimers.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-room replication procedure and replication log (`B44: partial` until third-party human replication).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions for AI coding and verification agents.

## Formal Proofs (Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0)
- [lean/PalomarChallenge.lean](lean/PalomarChallenge.lean): Isolated Palomar challenge statements (23 targets).
- [lean/PalomarSolution.lean](lean/PalomarSolution.lean): Zero-sorry Palomar solution module.
- [lean/comparator.json](lean/comparator.json): Six-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid` specification.
- [lean/VerifyAxioms.lean](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean): Axiom auditor for all 38 declarations (output frozen in `results/lean_axioms.txt`).
- [lean/WeylMagic/TwoAdicObstruction.lean](lean/WeylMagic/TwoAdicObstruction.lean): Pillar 1 (`T1a`-`T1d`).
- [lean/WeylMagic/BentHyperplaneRupture.lean](lean/WeylMagic/BentHyperplaneRupture.lean): Pillar 2 (`T2a`-`T2e`, universal Rothaus bound + all 896 n=4 bent functions).
- [lean/WeylMagic/SuperMubAnomalies.lean](lean/WeylMagic/SuperMubAnomalies.lean): Pillar 3 (`T3a`-`T3e`, exact Z[zeta_8] MUBs + Z[i] Super-MUB alpha-crossover).
- [lean/WeylMagic/TwoStabilizerTower.lean](lean/WeylMagic/TwoStabilizerTower.lean): Pillar 4 (`T4a`-`T4d`, n=1..3 unification, n=4 cubic, n=5 SOS rupture, AME ceilings).
- [lean/WeylMagic/Char3AlltopAndQGT.lean](lean/WeylMagic/Char3AlltopAndQGT.lean): Pillar 5 (`T5a`-`T5d`, divided-power Z_9 char-3 Alltop, char-5 Alltop, exact QGT).
- [lean/WeylMagic/NonVacuity.lean](lean/WeylMagic/NonVacuity.lean) & [lean/WeylMagic/AdversarialTests.lean](lean/WeylMagic/AdversarialTests.lean): 5 non-vacuity witnesses + 8 boundary refutations.

## Polyglot Verifiers & Paper
- [rust/src/lib.rs](rust/src/lib.rs): Safe (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`) exact `i128` verifier through D=81.
- [zig/src/main.zig](zig/src/main.zig): Comptime FWHT + exact `i128` verifier.
- [asm/fwht_x64.asm](asm/fwht_x64.asm) & [c/src/weyl_magic.c](c/src/weyl_magic.c): Dual-ABI x86-64 NASM + strict ISO C11 verifier, fuzzer, CBMC harness, and QGTL bridge.
- [cpp/magic_search.cpp](cpp/magic_search.cpp): Multi-start Riemannian L-BFGS search across order-8/16 abelian groups.
- [node/moonlab_crosscheck.cjs](node/moonlab_crosscheck.cjs): Classical Moonlab WASM simulator & bit-exact QRNG twin.
- [src/weyl_magic/oracle.py](src/weyl_magic/oracle.py) & [reference/oracle.py](reference/oracle.py): Exact Fraction/Decimal oracle + textbook O(D^3) reference oracle.
- [paper/main.tex](paper/main.tex): 14-page zero-warning AMS-LaTeX manuscript (`dist/Donahue_2026_weyl_magic_obstruction_frontier.pdf`, `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`).
- [docs/site/index.html](docs/site/index.html) & [docs/site/blueprint.html](docs/site/blueprint.html): Zero-CDN WebGL2 Observatory and Proof Blueprint DAG.
